system.description:
Small crystals (AC -4 [AAC 23], 10 HP) that orbit the bearer's head while active (10% chance any found stone is gray, burned out, and worthless):

  • Clear Ellipsoid: +5 Spell Points (see Archomancy).
  • Light Green Sphere: +1 1st-level spell/day.
  • Medium Green Sphere: +1 2nd-level spell/day.
  • Dark Green Sphere: +1 3rd-level spell/day.
  • Light Blue Prism: Cast Cure Light Wounds on self (1/day).
  • Dark Blue Prism: Cast Cure Serious Wounds on self (1/day).
  • Puce Spindle: Grants continuous Read Languages.
